synopsis: MAPE is used to compare signal amplitude, range and point-cloud quantities in lidar sensor models [f7765]. The booklet reports clear-weather lidar-model errors of 1.7% for signal amplitude and 8.5% for point count [f14781, f14782]. Chapter 10 and the glossary agree that these applications report MAPE rather than use it as a thresholded acceptance criterion, so the reported values do not establish an acceptance threshold [f7766, f14787]. Interpretation also requires caution: MAPE misbehaves near zero measured values and, like MAE and RMSE, hides the shape of simulation-versus-measurement errors [f14783, f14785].

relations.note: Both describe MAPE as reported, not a thresholded acceptance criterion.
